stdout:
usage: fleet-switchboard handoff [-h] --issue ISSUE --brief-file BRIEF_FILE
                                 [--name NAME] [--dir DIR]
                                 [--workspace WORKSPACE]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --issue ISSUE         The ask being handed off
  --brief-file BRIEF_FILE
                        The brief (Done so far, Next steps, Watch out for): a
                        file, or - for stdin
  --name NAME           The subagent's fleet name (default: cos-<issue>)
  --dir DIR             The subagent's working directory (default: here)
  --workspace WORKSPACE
                        The herdr workspace for its tab (default: the
                        workspace of this session, else $HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID)
